# An invoice paid by a block giving neither `account:` nor `bank_account:`.
#
# A payment has to come from an account, and nothing in the block says which.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_payment_block_gives_one_account.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-NO-ACCOUNT"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-NO-ACCOUNT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		memo: "Payment INV-NO-ACCOUNT"
